name: Level Link
description: Link two versions of a level and swap between them from the pause menu.

switch-key.name: Switch to Linked Level
switch-key.description: Press while paused in a linked level to swap to its linked version.

confirm-switch.name: Confirm Before Switching
confirm-switch.description: Show a yes/no popup before swapping to the linked level.

match-position.name: Match Position (Experimental)
match-position.description: Attempt to drop the player at the same X position in the linked level after switching. Physics, triggers and moving objects are NOT simulated, so this is visual-only and should never be used for legitimate leaderboard runs.

precache.name: Pre-download Linked Levels
precache.description: Download the linked online level in the background when you open a level page, so switching later is instant.
